typography.substitute_note: Plus Jakarta Sans Variable is the designated rounded humanist font substitute for Nunito (installed pre-baked family)

entry_surfaces./: Quick-commerce top header with delivery address picker + search bar, horizontal category filter chips, promo banners slider, product catalog grid with increment/decrement steppers, sticky bottom cart summary bar
entry_surfaces./login: Swiggy-style split/drawer auth sheet with Email+Password or Phone+OTP tabs, seeded demo credentials banner, interactive mock-OTP dialog helper
entry_surfaces./register: Mobile-first user onboarding screen with full name, email, phone number, and address pre-fill for seamless checkout
entry_surfaces./checkout: Swiggy/Zomato style multi-step checkout: Address & Delivery Instructions -> Payment Gateway Selection (Google Pay / UPI with QR & Deep Link vs COD) -> Bill Breakdown & Slide-to-Pay button
entry_surfaces./payment: Live UPI Payment Verification Gateway with animated timer, QR code scanner modal, Google Pay / PayTM / PhonePe deep links, and simulate payment result toggle for manual testing
entry_surfaces./tracking: Live Swiggy/Zomato Order Tracker screen with 15-min countdown timer, animated 4-stage progress timeline (Order Placed -> Packed -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered), delivery partner card, live WebSocket/polling status, order items receipt breakdown

header_nav.description: Sticky top bar with Unga Market brand logo in rich green, location selector dropdown ('Deliver to: Indiranagar, Bengaluru'), search input with clear icon, user auth status badge, and cart button with dynamic item badge.

product_card.description: Clean, high-density card displaying product image, fresh badge, title, weight/unit (e.g., 500g), original MRP (strikethrough #9CA3AF), offer price (#111827 bold), and an explicit ADD button or +/- counter stepper with green #0F8A3E background when active.

sticky_cart_bar.description: Swiggy/Zomato style floating bottom bar that appears when items > 0. Shows item count, total price, free delivery indicator, and an action button 'VIEW CART ->' in vibrant orange (#F26522).
sticky_cart_bar.position: fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 max-w-lg mx-auto z-40

cart_sheet.description: Full bottom sheet / drawer with item breakdown, quantity modifiers, itemized bill (Item total, Delivery fee, Platform fee, Taxes, Savings tag in soft green), delivery instructions field, and proceed to checkout CTA.

upi_gateway_screen.description: Real Google Pay / UPI resilient payment gateway emulator. Displays total payable amount, QR Code, VPA/UPI ID ('unga.market@okicici' with copy button), direct app intent buttons ('Pay via Google Pay', 'Pay via PhonePe', 'Pay via PayTM'), countdown timer (05:00), and automated/manual payment confirmation simulator for quick testing.

live_order_tracker.description: Hero status page modeled after Swiggy/Zomato. Displays prominent estimated delivery time (e.g. 'Arriving in 14 mins'), delivery hero avatar + phone trigger, dynamic progress bar connecting 4 key milestones (Order Placed -> Being Prepared -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered), pulse animations on current state, and downloadable invoice/order JSON.

fresh_groceries.description: Fresh apples and citrus fruits in crates

accessibility.contrast_ratio: 4.5:1 minimum for all body text (#111827 or #4B5563 on #FFFFFF / #F7F8FA)
accessibility.screen_reader_labels: All item increment/decrement buttons carry aria-label='Increase quantity of [item]' / aria-label='Decrease quantity of [item]'

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where suitable for sticky bars or modals
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie no app-wide text-align: center rule in the CSS entry. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or rounded buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, slide effects, and active state indicators
Use generous spacing for padding and gaps. Cramped quick-commerce cards look cluttered
All key interactive elements MUST carry data-testid attributes according to data_testid_conventions
Ensure total compliance with base-ui / shadcn component rules (no asChild, use render prop or className on standard elements)
